mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvBuyerClosingAmtPopList*/ SELECT MAX(BUYER_NAME) BUYER_NAME, SUM(AMT) AMT, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = KEP_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE ='KA')) KEP_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = KEP_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE ='KA')) PHONE_NUMBER, BUYER_CODE FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GRDT.BUYER ) AS BUYER_NAME, AGENT_ITEM_AMT AS AMT, ( SELECT MAX(KEP_USER_ID) FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND BUYER = GRDT.BUYER AND KEP_DEPT = GRDT.AP_CLOSE_DEPT AND POSITION_GROUP='PM' AND STATUS ='C') AS KEP_USER_ID, GRDT.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT WHERE STATUS <> 'D' AND AP_TAX_BILL_NO = #{st_tax_bill_no} ) GROUP BY BUYER_CODE
